This is Liftoff. Launch videos, proven before they go out.
AI can make a launch video in seconds. But nobody checks it. The logo flashes past, the text is hard to read, and the colours drift off brand.
With Liftoff, you paste a brand's website. It reads the name, the colours, the logo and the tone. There's no brief to fill in.
Next, it looks at what's working right now: viral Shorts from the last thirty days, in the brand's own category.
Before it makes a single frame, it writes down what done means. Ten checks, each one a number it can measure, or a clear yes or no.
Then a separate checker, from a different model family, measures every video. This one was sent back. The logo was on screen for two seconds, not three. The fixed version passed.
For poppi, all three videos passed every check. And it never needed to ask me once.
And it learns. Every miss becomes a rule, and a rule stays only if it helps on briefs it has never seen. Passing on the first try went from zero to fifty percent.
